title: Protocol for imaging proteins associated with Legionella-containing vacuoles in host cells
protocol: Warm up a new CYE plate at 37°C to remove condensation.
Pick up a single colony using a sterilized flat toothpick and re-streak it on the CYE plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 2 days (48 h).
Place sterilized round glass coverslips in the 24-well cell culture plates.
Set them up in triplicates for each sample.
Add 250 μL of 0.001% (w/v) poly L-lysine solution to the coverslip in each well of the 24-well plates.
Sink the coverslips using a sterilized pipet if they begin to float.
Gently incubate the plates in an orbital shaker for 1 h at room temperature (15°C–25°C).
Remove the poly-L-lysine solution.
Wash the coverslips in the wells with 500 μL/well of sterilized MilliQ water three times.
Remove the cell culture medium from the semi-confluent 10 cm dish with cells.
Add prewarmed 10 mL PBS.
Detach the cells from the dish for HEK293T-FcγRII cells.
Remove PBS.
Add 10 mL of prewarmed fresh DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Detach the cells by pipetting.
Transfer the cells to a sterilized 50-mL conical tube.
For HeLa-FcγRII cells, remove PBS.
Add 2 mL of the Trypsin/EDTA solution.
Incubate the dish for 5–10 min in a 37°C CO2 incubator.
Gently tap the dish to detach the cells.
Add 8 mL of prewarmed fresh DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS and suspend the cells by gentle pipetting.
Transfer the cells to a sterilized 50-mL conical tube.
Count the cell number using a hemocytometer.
Seed the cells into 24-well plates with PLL-coated coverslips (0.8 × 10^5 cells/well for HEK293T-FcγRII cells; 0.4 × 10^5 cells/well for HeLa-FcγRII cells).
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Replace the cell culture medium with fresh and prewarmed DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Transfect host cells with plasmid DNA encoding a GFP-tagged desired protein.
Dilute 1 μL of PEI with 50 μL of Opti-MEM in a 1.5-mL microfuge tube.
Incubate the tube for 15 min at room temperature (15°C–25°C).
Add 1.25 μL of a 100 ng/μL endotoxin-free plasmid to the tube.
Incubate the tube at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 15 min.
Drop PEI/plasmid/Opti-MEM mixture into cells seeded in the 24-well plates.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 24 h.
Prepare L. pneumophila suspension in sterilized MilliQ water.
Scrape an appropriate amount of a 2-day heavy patch of L. pneumophila grown on a CYE plate using a sterile pipette tip or flat toothpick.
Resuspend the scraped bacteria in 500 μL of sterilized MilliQ water.
Mix the bacterial solution well using a vortex.
Measure the absorbance of the suspension using a spectrophotometer at 600 nm (OD600).
Prepare the bacterial suspension with an OD600 value of 0.1 in a new 1.5-mL microfuge tube.
Supplement 2 mL of prewarmed DMEM with 10% FBS.
Add 0.7 μL of anti-Legionella rabbit serum to the supplemented medium.
Mix 16 μL (or 8 μL for HeLa-FcγRII) of bacterial suspension at 1 × 10^5 cells/μL with the medium containing anti-Legionella antibody.
Shake the tubes at 37°C at 250 rpm for 30 min.
Dispense DMEM containing opsonized L. pneumophila to cell culture wells (500 μL/well).
Centrifuge the cell culture plate at 220 × g for 5 min at room temperature with a swing bucket rotor.
Float the plate in a 37°C water bath for 5 min immediately after centrifugation stops.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 55 min.
Gently wash cells with prewarmed PBS (1 mL/well) three times to remove extracellular bacteria.
Add prewarmed DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator as required.
Wash the cells with prewarmed PBS (1 mL/well) three times at the time of sampling.
Remove PBS and add 500 μL/well of 4% PFA/PBS solution to fix the cells.
Incubate the plates at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 15 min.
Wash the cells with PBS (1 mL/well) three times.
Wash the cells on coverslips in 24-well cell culture plates with prewarmed 500 μL/well of semi-permeabilization buffer twice.
Remove the semi-permeabilization buffer and add 500 μL/well of fresh semipermeabilization buffer containing 3 μg/mL digitonin.
Incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 4 minutes.
Gently wash the cells with 500 μL/well of semi-permeabilization buffer three times.
Add 250 μL/well of semi-permeabilization buffer containing 1–10 μg/mL protein to be analyzed.
Incubate the plates at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 1 hour.
Wash the cells with prewarmed 500 μL/well of the semi-permeabilization buffer twice.
Add 500 μL of 4% PFA/PBS solution to the plates and incubate at room temperature (15°C–25°C) for 15 minutes.
Wash the cells with PBS (1 mL/well) three times.
Add 500 μl of 2% GS/PBS per well to the fixed cells.
Incubate the plates at room temperature for 30 min.
Remove the coverslips from the wells using sharp-tip tweezers and place them upside down on drops of diluted anti-Legionella rat serum prepared in 2% GS/PBS.
Incubate the coverslips at room temperature for 1 hour in a closed container.
Replace the coverslips in the wells with 1 ml of PBS (cell-side up).
Wash the coverslip with PBS three times.
Remove PBS from the plates.
Add 500 μL of 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS to permeabilize cell organelles.
Gently rock the plates using an orbital shaker at room temperature for 20 min.
Wash the cells with PBS (1 mL/well) three times.
Add 500 μL of blocking solution (2% GS/PBS) per well.
Incubate the plates at room temperature for 30 min.
Remove the coverslips from the wells of the plates.
Place the coverslips on drops (40 μL) of diluted anti-Legionella rabbit serum (1:5,000 dilution) prepared in 2% GS/PBS to stain intracellular bacteria.
Incubate the coverslips at room temperature for 1 h in a closed container.
Replace the coverslips in the wells with 1 mL of PBS (cell-side up).
Wash the coverslips with PBS (1 mL/well) three times.
Remove the coverslips from the wells of the plates.

Place the coverslips on drops (40 μL) of the secondary antibody solution containing Alexa Fluor 350-conjugated anti-rat IgG (1: 500 dilution) and Rhodamine Red-X-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1: 1000 dilution) prepared in 2% GS/PBS.
Incubate the coverslips at room temperature for 30 min in a closed container.
Remove the coverslips from the wells of the plates.
Place the coverslips on drops (40 μL) of the secondary antibody solution containing DAPI and Rhodamine Red-X-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG prepared in 2% GS/PBS.
Incubate the coverslips at room temperature for 30 min in a closed container.
Replace the coverslips in the wells with 1 mL of PBS (cell-side up) in the 24-well plates.
Wash the coverslips with PBS three times (1 mL/well).
Briefly wash the coverslips with sterilized MilliQ water once (1 mL/well).
Mount the coverslips on glass slides with ProLongTM Diamond Antifade Mountant without DAPI.
Let the samples dry in a dark place at room temperature overnight (18–20 h).
Set up a glass slide on a 100× oil-immersion objective lens to observe the sample.
Observe cells without semi-permeabilization.
Find an intracellular L. pneumophila, i.e., LCV (positive for red signal, negative for blue signal).
Check whether the LCV is associated with green signals (GFP-positive) or not.
Semi-permeabilize cells.
Find an LCV (positive for red signal) and DAPI staining (blue signal).
Check whether the LCV is associated with green signals (GFP-positive) or not.
Count at least 100 LCVs for each sample.
Perform statistical analysis using Student’s t tests for the data obtained from three independent experiments.
